description: Row G (Go Gin + GORM/SQLite): make the tag, author and favorited list filters combine (AND) with correct counts and paging.
setup: test "$(go env CGO_ENABLED)" = 1 || { echo 'row G needs cgo for mattn/go-sqlite3: the image has no C compiler (gcc, libc6-dev)' >&2; exit 1; }
notes: Hidden tests are Go tests in package articles (the repo's framework and layout). They use only the public HTTP API (register, create article, favorite, list) through a router they build themselves, with their own helper names, and rely on unit_test.go's TestMain for the SQLite test database; unique usernames and tags keep them independent of other rows. On the pinned SHA the filters are an else-if chain, so tag+author returns every article with the tag and the run fails. The hidden tests and the reference patch were type-checked offline with go vet against the cached modules; they have not been run. Setup step 1 turns a missing C toolchain into a skipped run with a clear reason: mattn/go-sqlite3 needs cgo, and bench/container/Dockerfile doesn't install gcc yet. Scoring runs offline (GOPROXY=off), so setup must have downloaded every module. budget_usd is a placeholder sized for a medium task.
